priorities.heading: Maine Jobs and Workforce Development
priorities.quote: As Chairman of the Senate Appropriations Committee, Susan has secured millions of dollars in federal investments for workforce development and training programs.

priorities.heading: Health Care
priorities.quote: She has led efforts to expand access to care including legislation to make key telehealth flexibilities permanent through Medicare so patients can connect with providers from home, reducing barriers for patients and providers.

priorities.heading: Alzheimer’s
priorities.quote: She secured a $100 million increase for Alzheimer’s research at NIH in Fiscal Year 2026, bringing total investment to $3.9 billion this year.

health-care.heading: Pass Medicare for All
health-care.quote: Troy believes health care is a right, not a privilege, and supports Medicare for All so every American can get the care they need without worrying about premiums, deductibles, or the fear of going bankrupt because they got sick.

immigration.heading: Dismantle and abolish ICE
immigration.quote: This rogue agency must be abolished, and that’s what Troy will fight to do in the Senate.

foreign-policy.heading: End the genocide in Gaza and stop U.S. funding for Israel's military
foreign-policy.quote: Troy believes what's happening in Gaza is a genocide, that Benjamin Netanyahu is a war criminal, and the U.S. government has a responsibility to not enable that suffering.
